script:
import ast, gzip, hashlib, json, math, subprocess, sys, symtable, builtins
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ROOT=Path('/home/fenics/Projects/NN-Lab'); DOC=ROOT/'docs/task042_neural_coarse_inverse'; REC=DOC/'outcomes/records'
HEAD='d21f67b1afa09ccf4113a8fb2a9f1b57eb11adf1'; BASE='5c8dc23a3be85075c54eb6f13e5b1c93a026448d'; SOURCE='1fe058e3d120c42d197531139fc62e02a1a2cd5f'
OUT=ROOT/'tmp/task042/review_v30'
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=ROOT)
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def read(name): return json.loads((REC/name).read_text())
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==HEAD
verified={}; skipped=[]; mismatches=[]
def verify(obj):
    if isinstance(obj,dict):
        if isinstance(obj.get('path'),str) and isinstance(obj.get('sha256'),str):
            p=Path(obj['path']); p=(p if p.is_absolute() else ROOT/p).resolve()
            assert p.is_relative_to(ROOT), p
            if p.suffix in ('.npz','.npy','.h5','.bin'):
                skipped.append(str(p)); return
            raw=p.read_bytes()
            if sha(raw)!=obj['sha256']:
                mismatches.append(dict(path=str(p),reported=obj['sha256'],actual=sha(raw)))
            else:
                if 'bytes' in obj: assert len(raw)==obj['bytes'],p
                verified[str(p)]=dict(sha256=sha(raw),bytes=len(raw))
        if 'original_path' in obj and 'archive' in obj:
            raw=gzip.decompress(Path(obj['archive']['path']).read_bytes())
            assert sha(raw)==obj['original_sha256'] and len(raw)==obj['original_bytes']
            assert raw==Path(obj['original_path']).read_bytes(),obj['original_path']
        for value in obj.values(): verify(value)
    elif isinstance(obj,list):
        for value in obj:verify(value)
for name in ('source_inventory_v32.json','evidence_integrity_v32.json','raw_evidence_index_v32.json','input_inventory_v32.json','run_index_v32.json','qualification_v32.json'):
    verify(read(name))
source_inventory=read('source_inventory_v32.json')
for p in source_inventory['source_files_same_as_qualified_and_run']:
    assert (ROOT/p).read_bytes()==git('show',SOURCE+':'+p),p
qualified=read('qualification_v32.json')
for p,h in qualified['implementation_hashes'].items():assert sha((ROOT/p).read_bytes())==h,p
changed=git('diff','--name-only',BASE,HEAD).decode().splitlines()
compiled=[]
for rel in changed:
    if rel.endswith('.py'):
        p=ROOT/rel; compile(p.read_text(),rel,'exec');compiled.append(rel)
old=git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',BASE,str(DOC.relative_to(ROOT))).decode().splitlines()
history=[p for p in old if Path(p).name.startswith(('review_report_v','response_v'))]
for p in history: assert git('show',BASE+':'+p)==(ROOT/p).read_bytes(),p
suffixes=[]
for p in ('README.md','outcomes/summary.md','outcomes/test_summary.md','outcomes/changed_files.md'):
    rel=str((DOC/p).relative_to(ROOT));assert (DOC/p).read_bytes().endswith(git('show',BASE+':'+rel));suffixes.append(p)
for row in read('evidence_integrity_v32.json')['old_closed_files_unchanged']:
    if Path(row['path']).name=='ledger.json':assert json.loads(Path(row['path']).read_text())['closed']
cases=ET.fromstring(gzip.decompress((REC/'tests_junit_xml_v32.gz').read_bytes())).findall('.//testcase')
assert len(cases)==12 and all(len(x)==0 for x in cases)
assert len({(x.attrib['classname'],x.attrib['name']) for x in cases})==12
raw=json.loads(gzip.decompress((REC/'raw_result_v32.json.gz').read_bytes()))
manifest=json.loads(gzip.decompress((REC/'run_manifest_v32.json.gz').read_bytes()))
ledger=read('ledger_v32.json');expected=read('actual_consumption_v32.json')['expected']
assert ledger==json.loads((ROOT/'tmp/task042/v32/ledger.json').read_text())
assert ledger['closed'] and ledger['active'] is None and len(ledger['runs'])==1
assert raw['budget_counts']==manifest['completed_budget_counts']==ledger['charged']==expected
assert raw['action_counts']==manifest['completed_action_counts']==dict(S=34,SH=2,audit=0)
assert raw['source_sha']==manifest['source_sha']==SOURCE
assert len(raw['factor_reloads'])==7
for row in raw['factor_reloads']:
    assert row['solve_calls']==row['RHS_columns']==4 and row['triangular_passes']==8
    for w in row['witnesses']:
        assert w['solve_error_norm']/w['rhs_norm']<=1e-8
        assert w['solve_error_norm']/w['solve_operand_scale']<=1e-12
        for key in ('original_principal_action','original_adjoint_action'):
            if key in w: assert w[key]['error_norm']/w[key]['operation_scale']<=1e-10
cost=read('resource_costs_v32.json');resource=[];admissions=[]
for phase in ('pre','actor','checker'):
    sup=read('supervision_'+phase+'_v32.json')
    samples=[json.loads(s) for s in gzip.decompress((REC/('resources_'+phase+'_v32.jsonl.gz')).read_bytes()).splitlines()]
    assert len(samples)==sup['samples']
    for row in samples:
        assert row['rss_bytes']==sum(x['rss_bytes'] for x in row['members'])
        assert row['swap_bytes']==sum(x['swap_bytes'] for x in row['members'])
    assert max(x['rss_bytes'] for x in samples)==sup['sampled_process_tree_rss_peak_bytes']
    assert max(x['swap_bytes'] for x in samples)==0
    assert sup['classification']=='COMPLETED' and sup['leader_exit_code']==0 and sup['descendants_cleared']
    assert sup['elapsed_seconds']==cost[phase+'_seconds']
    resource.append(dict(phase=phase,seconds=sup['elapsed_seconds'],sample_count=len(samples),rss=sup['sampled_process_tree_rss_peak_bytes']))
    d=json.loads(gzip.decompress((REC/('admission_'+phase+'_v32.json.gz')).read_bytes()))
    fractions={int(k):v for k,v in d['cpu_busy_fractions'].items()}
    for key,b in d['cpu_ticks_before'].items():
        a=d['cpu_ticks_after'][key];busy=1-(a[3]-b[3]+a[4]-b[4])/max(sum(a)-sum(b),1)
        assert abs(busy-fractions[int(key)])<1e-15
    for tid,a in d['thread_ticks_after'].items():
        b=d['thread_ticks_before'].get(tid)
        if b and a[0]==b[0]:assert d['thread_delta_ticks'][tid]==a[1]-b[1]
    reasons={}
    for cpu,value in fractions.items():
        if value>.05:reasons.setdefault(cpu,[]).append('sample_busy_fraction_gt_0.05')
    for proc in d['neighbor_processes']:
        for t in proc['threads']:
            if len(t['affinity'])<=16:
                for cpu in t['affinity']:reasons.setdefault(cpu,[]).append('narrow_thread_affinity:'+str(t['tid']))
            elif d['thread_delta_ticks'].get(str(t['tid']),1)>0:reasons.setdefault(t['cpu'],[]).append('active_wide_thread:'+str(t['tid']))
    decisions=[dict(**t,eligible=not any(c in reasons for c in t['siblings']),excluded_siblings={str(c):reasons[c] for c in t['siblings'] if c in reasons}) for t in d['topology']]
    assert decisions==d['cpu_decisions']
    assert [t['cpu'] for t in decisions if t['eligible']]==d['candidate_cpus']
    admissions.append(dict(phase=phase,cpu=d['selected_cpu'],static_cpu_replay=True))
assert math.isclose(cost['carry_seconds']+sum(x['seconds'] for x in resource),cost['cumulative_seconds'],abs_tol=1e-12)
cleanup=read('storage_cleanup_v32.json')
assert len(cleanup['files'])==506 and sum(x['bytes'] for x in cleanup['files'])==10722813
assert all((ROOT/x['path']).suffix=='.pyc' and not (ROOT/x['path']).exists() for x in cleanup['files'])


metrics=[]
for row in raw['rows']:
    g=row['eta10']/row['eta9'];c=row['h_e9_coherence']
    assert abs(g-row['g10'])<1e-14 and abs(g-math.sqrt(1-c*c))<1e-11
    assert g>=.95
    metrics.append(dict(name=row['name'],eta9=row['eta9'],eta10=row['eta10'],g10=g,
        coherence=c,norm_gain_percent=100*(1-g),squared_gain_percent=100*(1-g*g),
        outside_growth=row['regions']['outside_J']['return_response_norm']/row['regions']['outside_J']['qj_response_norm']))
out=dict(schema='task042.review30.independent.v1',utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),reviewed_HEAD=HEAD,actual_source=SOURCE,previous_review=BASE,
    changed_files=changed,compiled_files=compiled,verified_metadata=verified,metadata_hash_mismatches=mismatches,
    skipped_large_payloads=sorted(set(skipped)),scalar_metrics_recomputed=metrics,
    old_reviews_responses_unchanged=history,historical_suffixes=suffixes,old_closed_files=12,
    raw_archives_lossless=True,raw_junit_passed=len(cases),resources=resource,admissions=admissions,
    costs=cost,consumption=expected,cleanup=dict(files=506,bytes=10722813,only_bytecode=True),
    no_original_actions=True,no_factor_reads=True,no_solves=True,no_QR_SVD=True,no_new_test_run=True,
    cached_array_recalculation='NOT_RUN: unique fresh CPU admission rejected; no retry, no numeric worker',
    review_admission=json.loads((OUT/'admission.json').read_text()),
    script=Path(__file__).read_text())
(OUT/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(metadata_files=len(verified),mismatches=mismatches,changed_files=len(changed),compiled_files=len(compiled),old_documents=len(history),metrics=metrics),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
